notes.title: Evospace 0.18.5 Update 3
notes.notes:
New network graph

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/db33c4c50d476912bb6cca24db6f850c51b675ea.gif

The electric network code has been optimized for more even distribution, and the issue of skipped consumers has been fixed.

Significant improvements include a 50% reduction in computing time for resource networks, achieved by eliminating the shuffle step. This efficiency is possible as the network now accurately distributes power based on the known power requirements of all consumers.

Note that with multiple heavy consumers and numerous small ones, some operational changes may occur. Additionally, the precision of requested values could vary due to electricity buffers in some machines.

Logic Circuit UI improvements

Now you can select rule signals from input signals.
Logic circuit UI was improved.

notes.title: Update #18
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=SBbsS2uhNCg;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 0.18 is the biggest update for Evospace to date.

The game engine has been completely overhauled to support mods, as well as to improve performance and ensure the operation of bases that are larger than the range of sight.
Fps should improve dramatically for all users, especially on large bases. Now you can expand them not only in height, which will further increase productivity.

Updated UI and building hologram
[previewyoutube=RiMfcBpTlWs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/60c33a24457f7ddd9feaf7f47c52c88ae9e91a9f.gif

Robot arm confguration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/636c7ae7ce36514e8da1025ace50c6ea4d0be38b.gif

Most of the blocks have lost theinputs and outputs for items, instead of them, robotic arms are now used. This system has proven itself to be much more flexible and versatile.

Flywheels and pumps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/dfbc14f4b8d45dcad2de45a5a4516cf6c08c48c4.png
Inputs/outputs for liquids are also removed from the blocks. Pumps are used to manipulate fluids. Flywheels appeared to transfer kinetic energy.

Automated mining
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/80c3177385f5cb52f80024a3bea54a62f4845b67.png

Mining drills appeared for the extraction of ore and stone. At first, the resources in them will be infinite, but later there will be an option.

Researches
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/1d034c87d7e58918e882a05d50a9f1c7ceb06245.png

There were computers producing research points. The research system uses as a replacement for the old quests system. In the process, new machines and decorative blocks are unlocked.

Nuclear reactors, heat pipes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/ef3b5bd751e47d0ffa9e4d039b30fea5430ff88f.png

The way machines consume energy has changed. As before, the speed of their work depends on the level and is 1.5^level, the energy consumption factor now is 2^level. To ensure the consumption of energy, such advanced sources as a nuclear reactor appeared. Others will appear in the future.

Plastics and petrochemicals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/8a5d650349178cbe8713f57421da1ea637621696.png

World map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/d3a07073260a16074c77b408d835e0e10baaac82.png

Updated graphics and world generation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/cdd3a6f942fdf09d9a0b3176b87be775b343e606.png

This is an incomplete list of all the changes introduced in 0.18.

Join us on Discord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/dad6a9b90b564e5aa73bc6b483f2fffe4a255e80.png

notes.title: Update #17 fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/60c33a24457f7ddd9feaf7f47c52c88ae9e91a9f.gif
(new features in # 18)

Good news! We have made very significant progress with update #18.
Part of the engine regarding the work with the map and blocks has been redone.
In this case, it will remain possible to open maps of old versions.

The main theme and cause of global changes in the new version is mod support. It will also add integration with Steam Workshop, scenario support and performance improvement on large bases.

Meanwhile, a fairly large number of changes have published for 0.17, here are some of them:

Fixes

 bug with stacker fixed
 error displaying recipes multiple item output
 craft of the conveyor kunction line removed
 display of the advanced conveyor junction in the database has been removed
 fixed location in the database of electricity, kinetics and heat
 rods replaced with parts
 rings, bolts, impellers, springs removed
 added recipes for growing plants on a farm
 added steel blast furnace
 added button and switch
 increased number of quests
 added copying of block settings, copying support is implemented for conveyor junction, logic circuits
 added simplified reinforced cement recipe
 modified wire recipe
 modified electrolyzer recipe
 added pneumatic input interface for working with roboarms
 added conveyor junction interface for working with roboarms
 added support for changing keys to display recipes
 sprint feature added
 signs added
 many changes have been made to improve performance

notes.title: Update #17
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/ae839ab8609e4fae438fbf20bd5741b433c64781.gif 

The wires have been redone, now they form power grids, they do not have a dependence on the FPS bandwidth, they allow you to view the statistics of energy production and consumption through their UI, and when you close the game, they don’t lose the energy contained in them as before.

Switches and logic switches now set the direction of the electricity flow.

 Logic 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/7660aedadd5896d58d38c333d623fc7edc70f175.png 

Reworked logical wires that also now form networks. Now you can connect logic wires in 3 dimensions.

Added advanced logic to compare numbers.

A sensor has been added that allows you to export the number of items contained in a chest or the battery charge.

 New production 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/6d40ae39173a7cecc36a3fad08ac02a71e6394c8.png 

A new Freezer block has been added. It is used to freeze air, as well as to cool hot ingots, such as tungsten and hardmetal (and neutron)

Added chain of oxygen production from frozen air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34328861/b374db61f91eac32398ba02d3ba7162654bd11e5.png 

Added Hard Metal production chain.

 World generation changes 

Ore deposits have been completely removed.
Added some simple map generator templates.

 Other changes 

The multi-tool robotic arm now collects the blocks dug by it. The exit for objects is below

Direct and return heat exchangers are added. They can be used to transport or remove heat.

A lot of work has been done to improve the performance of the game on large bases.

The method of scaling recipes has been redone, now accelerated recipes do not give out servings more often, but have large servings.

Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when trying to load a map saved with an error (for example, due to a sudden power failure to the PC)

 Minor changes 


 Added decorative blocks
 Added sounds for some skipped blocks
 Added jetpack interface
 Fixed bug with walk sounds
 Added visual difference in multitool levels
 Changed hints displayed when hovering over an item
 Improved logic chip interface
 Added animation of the disappearance of objects lying in the world
 Changed the mechanics of the stack of items in the world, items stack by type and update
stack lifetime while stacking
 The mechanism for adapting the eye to light is off. Lighting adjusted accordingly
 Added flat variation for monitors
 Added double and triple stackers
 Added disassembler
 Changed the way to select a recipe in the assembler
 Added pneumatic input model

notes.title: Update #16
notes.notes:
Logic Elements

Earlier in the game appeared difficult for the machine recipes. For example, a copper hammer is difficult to handle steel ingots. A complex recipe is much slower, a very compex one leads to a breakdown of the machine.

Now simple recipes have been added to this mechanics. They run faster. This mechanic has replaced the old machine speed bonus.

 Pumpkin Farms 

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/1227f8cd2d0ef267c6e6bd396405d62e014a34cf.png 

Appeared pumpkin farms, as a source of organic. And in the future for pumpkin pies!

notes.title: Update #15
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/2ef355111c82ff63c2d2b1afeb3eb9c0972831b5.gif

 Recipe Levels 
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/945cf0536361d26cfbcfb92cc521cc37d5ea9131.png 

Recipes now have their own levels. The level affects the execution of the recipe by the machine. If the level of the recipe is higher than the level of the machine, the speed of execution is significantly reduced. If the recipe level is higher than the machine level by 2, then the machine will gradually break down when executed. A broken machine can be fixed at the moment by simple reinstallation, a repair tool will appear very soon.

 High capacity batteries 
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/1d02711dfecc1da2a95122e53c4b3eadb604ea98.png 

A new energy storage unit has appeared, however they have a small drain, due to the fact that they need to be heated. In the cooled state they can store energy, but can not give and receive it.

 Getting titanium 
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/d3578f3cb5b71f2ef5231d2bd04daba752eda182.png 

There was a way to get titanium from ore, and, accordingly, all titanium machines.

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/aebe3d4e19a3db436a4d42b4e9a8f5480088d98c.png 

Can be used to transfer items between machines. You can line up to create simple and slow ways to move items.

Also significantly increased the yield of recipes that create decorative blocks.

Added support for machine modules and breakdowns. Machines no longer have a speed bonus for material. Instead, the material gives different durability. The level of the machine also does not affect the speed, but gives a different number of slots for the modules.

notes.title: Update #10
notes.notes:
Stainless steel 

There was a way to produce stainless steel. The first unique block in this tier is Terminal.

 Terminal 

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/436d77275ae194bfe57b1950e1a52549709834b0.jpg 

Useful for monitoring the progress of crafting, the contents of chests. It can display the interface of any block. The image is configured via terminal interface.

It is worth noting that items can be dragged from the terminal just like from the block gui.

 Industrial separator 

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/76fc8edd61aa9e67be5139054643adf5bd0c392a.jpg 

An improved version of separator allows deeper processing of dust. Does not reduce the output of metal and gives additional products.

Necessary device for obtaining stainless steel components.

 Solid fuel stove 

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/46e643fea69a5391bcab64585917243d99e715de.jpg 

An improved version of the stone furnace, which allows to burn more energy-intensive mixtures, for example, termite. Reaction of burning termite is used to reduce oxides needed to produce stainless steel components: chromium and manganese.

 Radiator to destroy unnecessary heat

 Objects from the ground go first to inventory, not hotbar

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Localization

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/fdce68da817244c0101b0cf2d66289610f7f609e.png

We added localization support and Russian language.

Spawn point

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/a165abac1479b730213309dc6bab856de7f9f3bc.jpg

Clicking the right button on the bed, you can set the spawn point, as well at the bottom of the screen the direction to this point is always shown, to never lose your base.

Generating structures on the map

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/1bcda8056dcb37c0f0ef2197157dab0595ee4b29.jpg

The screenshot shows the generation of a conventional cube of bricks on a map, but houses, ruins, etc. can be generated in the same way.

The way of moving is slightly changed.

It was difficult to get out of the caves, so we added the ability to climb steep slopes, but the speed of movement depends on the angle of the surface.

Database categories

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/dfba4f5b20ec2e587285207e96419e3870af1145.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34328861/bf914a812f661226ab5f0ccd811a209fdbb3d0a4.jpg

And much more!
